01_bm25.text: Separate 2020 from 2021 model reviews please!. The 2021 model is a downgrade from the 2020 Moto G Power. (Do just a little homework & you'll read why.) Amazon should not be lumping their reviews together, as they have different specs and this is misleading to customers reading the reviews. I am pleased with my 2020 model Moto G Power. I feel it's a good value and quality for the money. Particularly pleased with the storage space. If you play games with any graphics intensity at all, know that the 3-day battery claim will not apply. I found that to be a disappointment, given how much battery life is hyped for the Moto G Power. I really only get a full day, maybe, out of the battery if I game a lot that day. If I hardly game at all, I think I get maybe a day & a half to 2 days, at a stretch.

Awesome Moto G Fast with Android v10. Upgraded from the Moto G5 Plus to the Moto G Fast (just out in June 2020). The phone is slightly larger than the G5, but it's lightning fast, easy to learn to use, three cameras, call screening!, and much much more. Overall, a solid phone with a modern OS, that won't disappoint.
Moto G Power 2020. Great phone! I love the long battery life. So many features and I have yet to use the facial recognition.

I Really Like This Phone. When I was looking to upgrade last year, I was comparing between this one (2020 Moto G Stylus) and the 2020 Moto G Power because they were both on sale and are pretty similar. I ended up choosing this one because of the more powerful camera. I really love it and I am very happy with my purchase.

Direct-to-ear call quality is as it should be but I avoid that so for me, the speakerphone is going to remain a real trade-off. But that’s the only drawback to the Moto G Stylus 2020, or perhaps just to phones with stereos speakers. In all other ways I’m finding the 2020 Moto G Stylus to be a mega value for anywhere near its price range.

This is really a great phone for the price.. I love my moto g power 2020. The speakers are loud. I actually have to turn it down. It is really fast, I play games on it , it doesn't crash and it loads fast. The battery life is great. I don't have to charge my phone every day. I charge my phone every 3 or 4 days.

A great budget phone, but the G Fast is still a better buy. This phone suits my needs. It has a nice matte finish, and it even gets though my tasks well. I give this device a good point for it's battery. However, the Moto G Fast, despite being a 2020 model, is still a better device in it's specs, so if you want those, get that instead. Otherwise, This is a great phone for essential users, and those who can't afford a flagship.
Battery doesn't last as long as the 2020 version.. My Moto G Power is a Great phone! BUT the 2021 is a BIG disappointment on the battery life! Doesn't last nearly as long; certainly not 3 days!

a reliable brand. Last October I purchased the 2020 Moto G Power for a friend. She had previously owned a Moto G5+ and after three years, the micro charge connection on that workhorse was weakening. I went on the Amazon to put a study on the latest from Motorola Android One unlocked. I read the reviews and specs on the 2020 G Power . The upgrade to the more robust type C charging port was noted. I ordered the 2020 Moto G Power and had it shipped to an Amazon drop where it arrived quickly and while my friend's old phone was still functional. The clerks at the facility helped her move the SIM card over, and transfer photos and files onto the new device. After restoring the navigation buttons, she became comfortable with the new phone. I've owned two Motorola phones myself and have recommended them to friends and family.

What carriers is my moto g stylus (2020) compatible with, you ask? They are all work horses. I had thought about buying the Moto G Fast but opted for the Moto G Power instead, glad that I did.

Excellent phone fast and it does the Job.. I bought the Moto G to replace my Samsung a20. the Moto G is fast and it does the Job, the battery life is good but not as advertised. if you are debating between the a20 and the Moto G get the Moto G is way better built on the screen dept. I had a Samsung a20 and had a protective case and a screen protector and the first time I accidently dropped it the screen bleed and turn black. the Moto G screen is not as bright as the A20 however it is stronger ( I have a screen protector and a case on the Moto G) for the price Motorola is excellent. Also I only used the phone for calls and some text messages and it works fine.
Moto g 2020. This phone is adequate at best. I needed a phone and upon recommendation, ordered this one, however it barely compares to my Samsung Galaxy, but for the price it will have to do.

Love This Phone (G power 2020). Went from a Essential Phone to the G Power. This phone can't be beat for the price. The battery life is wonderful (when screen brightness is not up). Some lag occasionally but overall fast response. Perfect phone if you aren't heavy into mobile gaming.

Can't go wrong with Motorola. I'm a relatively unpicky, average smart phone user who replaces their phone after 2-4 years (as needed by ever-growing app sizes and demands for processing power) but I don't need THE best phone out there. Right now (summer 2020) the Moto G Power is a "better" phone according to all of the nit-picky tech reviews, but only because it has slightly more internal storage and longer battery life (that's about the only real difference between the two! Otherwise it's the same phone). But the battery life on the G Fast is already far above average right now. Overall opinion: This Motorola G Fast is, refreshingly, THE BEST smart phone I've ever had, after about 15 years of using smart phones. I forgot just how solid Motorola is, as a brand. They made the first cell phone, so they know what they're doing!
Moto G Fast. Very complete product

Moto G Fast | Unlocked | Made for US by Motorola | 3/32GB | 16MP Camera | 2020 | White. Good phone for the money. Google wants to power and use all their apps, which try to sync it up to all their products and bugs the crud out of me when just trying to text and send a photo image.
Love this Motorola Moto g power. Great cellphone,long life battery ,fast and ver efficient
Motorola wants $25 to swap phone. I will buy a new phone, not made by Chinese owners of Motorola name, then sell this Moto G Power phone.

Worst phone I have ever owned. Bluetooth would constantly disconnect. Almost never had service with Verizon. Would drop calls regularly. Battery life was barely a day due to always looking for service, I replaced it with the 2020 moto g power and been happy

Good screen, finicky fingerprint reader, great battery standby time, good build quality, avg cams.... This is a good upgrade choice if battery capacity is your concern yet still managing to keep good price per performance. While its peers with similar specifications may have better cameras and performance boosts, the Moto G Power (2020) however is fairly feature-rich, inside is a larger-than-average 5,000mAh battery with good battery life for at least a day of medium-heavy use, 2 days of light-medium usage, and 3+ with light usage including standby times, which greatly reduces power consumption when the phone isn't being used in the moment, with great band support/carrier coverage and LTE speeds, a decent IPS panel with neutral color tone, dual-band (2.4ghz/5.8ghz) wifi, bluetooth 5.0, 4gb ram, 64gb internal storage for apps and other content with 512gb SD upgrade support, decent SoC performance with lag sometimes being an issue, great charging time from half capacity, and all of the necessary sensors for application support.

Moto G Power has excellent battery life. The battery life is so good, a few times I've tested it and got 3 days on 1 charge. Size if perfect, not too big or small. The Volume button and Power button are a little close.

Performance upgrade, battery life downgrade over previous similar models. I write this from the perspective of someone whose been using $200 Lenovo-Motorola phones with 5000 mah batteries since November 2017. My first of this category was a Moto E4 plus: very good battery life, good enough performance for the time. Then as my E4 plus aged and battery life declined I bought a Moto G7 Power: it had better specs in pretty much every way and had a longer battery life due to being new. When I ordered this phone I expected the same kind of upgrade: better performance specs, more battery life. Much to my surprise, the new G Power often lost battery % at the same or faster rate than my 17 month old G7 Power.

I feel it's a good value and quality for the money. Particularly pleased with the storage space. If you play games with any graphics intensity at all, know that the 3-day battery claim will not apply. I found that to be a disappointment, given how much battery life is hyped for the Moto G Power. I really only get a full day, maybe, out of the battery if I game a lot that day. If I hardly game at all, I think I get maybe a day & a half to 2 days, at a stretch.

Four--5 days on a charge!. There is a reason why the 2020 (NOT 2021) version of the Moto G-Power mobile phone was ranked by a prominent tech review company as the best bargain for a phone in the under $500 range. The same company slammed the 2021 version because it actually downgraded some components (do your research and grab a 2020 while you can). The battery life is fantastic, the 6.4" screen is very good, it comes with Android 10, but updates to Android 11 within one week of activation. It's processor is quick, and the cameras are respectable. If you want higher quality pictures, there are more expensive choices. For the average Joe or Jane, this G-Power provides the most bang for the buck.

I like this phone. The Moto G Power is a great phone for the money. The long battery life is refreshing after my previous phone which had a very short battery life and then took 3 hours to charge even at 90%. The Moto G Power lasts a long time and charges quickly.

Upgrade from MotoG5 Plus. Bought this as a replacement for my Moto G5 Plus as the battery life was on the way out after four years. Decided on the 2020 Power model after watching some YouTube videos comparing it to the 2021 Power. Overall I'm really happy with the battery life and app loading speed. Going from a front screen fingerprint reader on the Moto G5 to one on the back of the phone took some adjustment. But I've owned the phone for a few weeks now and haven't had any issues. Thought about getting a Samsung, but I wasn't ready to part with the Moto gestures haha.

Superior battery life.. This was a replacement for my LG G2 that I bought in 2013 which still works except for the latest apps. Moto G Power is surprisingly very affordable, 4G only (5G no thanks) and the battery life is the best I've seen since the Moto v600 flip.
Moto G Power 2020. Great phone! I love the long battery life. So many features and I have yet to use the facial recognition.

Has The Quality That I've Come to Expect From Motorola. The G Power 2020 model is excellent. Screen sharpness, sound quality and battery life. Upon activation and updates, the phone was updated to Android 11. I activated on Verizon. Restored the majority of my apps, settings, texts, contacts using Google. A high end phone at a bargain price.
Best value. Moto G Power 5000 mah battery will last. Near stock android without bloatware.

Pros A good battery life (but not excellent) A large display Good value for the money Cons Not so excellent battery life A heavier phone Poor fingerprint reader The whole reason for purchasing this phone for me was my previous generation Motorola now drains battery fast. I have had this phone for over 3 months, and while the battery holds the charge well, it's nowhere near the raving reviews I read. Keep in mind this is all relative to what you feel is battery should be at. I'm not the kind of person walking around with 20% of charge and ok being unprepared.

Separate 2020 from 2021 model reviews please!. The 2021 model is a downgrade from the 2020 Moto G Power. (Do just a little homework & you'll read why.) Amazon should not be lumping their reviews together, as they have different specs and this is misleading to customers reading the reviews. I am pleased with my 2020 model Moto G Power. I feel it's a good value and quality for the money. Particularly pleased with the storage space. If you play games with any graphics intensity at all, know that the 3-day battery claim will not apply. I found that to be a disappointment, given how much battery life is hyped for the Moto G Power. I really only get a full day, maybe, out of the battery if I game a lot that day. If I hardly game at all, I think I get maybe a day & a half to 2 days, at a stretch.

I do recommend a different case as well as a different screen protector. It should be noted that most, if not all, screen protectors won't totally cover the screen due to design. Truly the battery life is its highest selling point. The 3 day battery life advertisement is somewhat misleading, it is capable of 3 days without a charge as long as it's casual being used. However, with heavy usage on wifi or cellular broadband use it will last approximately 12-15 hrs of nonstop use- which is outstanding for me. As I write this review I've been downloading a large file, uploading my pictures to the cloud, taking and making calls, using messenger and the phone message app, as well as running a malware and virus scan in the background simultaneously. I might add at the time of this review my phone is at 47% battery life.

Good phone except may be for battery. Good phone, great price. Pros, My phone was made in 2021 and has android 10. Phone Made in india not china. Works well, fast. Cons, it is important to mention to potential buyers that battery life is poor. I found out about it after i ordered. There is a website that lists endurance rating for phone batteries. This one is among the bottom. Even just sitting, battery drops by 1% per hr or two. When you actually use it go figure. Guess its ok but there are much better ones out there ( including Motorola) but not at this great price, so there it is

Long lasting battery. My Samsung S8 liked being charged really out of the box. Got to having to be charged 3-4 times a day. The Moto advertised long lasting battery, I can go from getting up to going to bed without having to charge it. Pictures are great don't listen to negative junk comments about quality. Maybe if you are a studio photographer and I'm not paying anyone to take my picture using a cell phone. Everything works great and I'm using Microsoft Launcher to get me back to buttons at bottom. Saw a tech review like no buttons was a big deal, ha what a joke. And, the price is perfect to have a stylus pen also. Buy one you will not regret it. I haven't.
All day battery.. Fantastic battery life. My boy uses it all day and had 70% battery left.
Phone does everything. I don't like the fact that it did not come with a owner's manual . I worked through most of the functions but am still learning how to use it.
Battery life is what was advertised. Battery life is excellent and it was a well received gift. I would buy it again

The Iphone owners in the family are probably right that their phone cameras are better. But this is plenty good enough for me, and an improvement over anything I’ve had. I’ve even found the macro camera useful. Haven’t used the panorama camera yet. I’ve seen a couple of Youtube videos that persuade me the G Stylus will be user serviceable if/when the time comes, unlike some of the lower-end Motorolas. I’d rather not deal with adhesives at all, but I don’t think that’s a choice left to smart phone owners. If the battery or the USB port needs replacing or there’s water ingress, I could deal with that. Will parts be available as they’ve been with the Note phones? I’m not sure.
Not a good used cellphone.. The phone had the prior owners information on the Facebook lite account, and I wasn't able to pull up my Facebook lite account. It was very frustrating.
